definitions.explanation: Not in a direct line or manner; through an intermediary or secondary means.

examples.japanese: {間接|かんせつ}⟦{的|てき}→的：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
{間接|かんせつ}⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The room's atmosphere changed with indirect lighting.

examples.japanese: {間接|かんせつ}⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：08000_kitsuen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Secondhand smoking is also bad for your health.
examples.notes: {間接|かんせつ}⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：08000_kitsuen⟧ = passive/secondhand smoking

notes:
{間接|かんせつ} means indirect, as opposed to ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧ (direct).

Common collocations:
- {間接|かんせつ}⟦{的|てき}→的：noentry⟧（な/に）(indirect(ly))
- {間接|かんせつ}⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧ (indirect lighting)
- {間接|かんせつ}⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：08000_kitsuen⟧ (passive smoking)
- {間接|かんせつ}⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ (indirect tax, e.g., consumption tax)
- {間接|かんせつ}⟦{話法|わほう}→話法：noentry⟧ (indirect speech - grammar)

Opposite:
- ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧ (direct)

Note: Different from ⟦{関節|かんせつ}→関節：noentry⟧ (joint - body part), which is a homophone.
